project.description: Application web de gestion de tâches avec tableau Kanban.
project.brief: Créer une application de gestion de projet avec dashboard, Kanban à trois colonnes, détail et édition des tâches, et sauvegarde locale.

tasks.title: Initialize project structure
tasks.description: Create the folders, HTML pages and ES modules, and set up Tailwind.
userStories: As a developer, I want a clean project structure so that the team can work efficiently.

tasks.title: Design UI mockups
tasks.description: Sketch the dashboard, the creation form and the task board.
userStories: As a user, I want a clear interface so that I can understand the app quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Mockups are validated by the team.

tasks.title: Build header and navigation
tasks.description: Create the shared header with logo, links and settings access.
userStories: As a user, I want a navigation bar so that I can move between pages.

tasks.title: Create the storage module
tasks.description: Write helpers to read and write projects in localStorage and the API key in sessionStorage.
userStories: As a user, I want my data saved so that I do not lose it after a reload.
acceptanceCriteria: API key is stored in sessionStorage only.

tasks.title: Create the task board layout
tasks.description: Build the three-column Kanban (To Do, In Progress, Done).
userStories: As a user, I want to see my tasks in a board so that I can follow the progress of my project.

tasks.title: Create the task card component
tasks.description: Render ID, title, priority badge, size badge, estimated time, deadline and dependencies.
userStories: As a user, I want informative cards so that I can understand a task at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: Each card shows all required fields.

tasks.title: Build the task detail modal
tasks.description: Open a modal on card click showing description, user stories and acceptance criteria.
userStories: As a user, I want to open a task so that I can read its full details.

tasks.title: Add task editing
tasks.description: Allow editing title, description, priority, size, deadline and status, persisted in storage.
userStories: As a user, I want to edit a task so that I can adapt the plan.

tasks.title: Enforce dependency rule on Done
tasks.description: Block moving a task to Done when a dependency is not Done and explain why.
userStories: As a user, I want consistent statuses so that the plan stays realistic.
acceptanceCriteria: Move is blocked with a clear message.
Move works when all dependencies are Done.

tasks.title: Implement task deletion
tasks.description: Delete a task with confirmation and remove it from other tasks' dependencies.
userStories: As a user, I want to delete a task so that I can remove irrelevant work.
acceptanceCriteria: No dependency references the deleted ID.

tasks.title: Dashboard project cards and progress
tasks.description: Display project cards with task counts and a progress bar computed from statuses.
userStories: As a user, I want to see each project's progress so that I know what remains.
acceptanceCriteria: Empty state message is shown with no project.

tasks.title: Responsive design and polish
tasks.description: Improve spacing, states and mobile behavior across all pages.
userStories: As a user, I want a comfortable interface on any device.

tasks.title: End-to-end testing
tasks.description: Test the full flow: create, view, edit, move and delete tasks.
userStories: As a user, I want a reliable app so that I can trust my plan.

tasks.title: Write documentation and deploy
tasks.description: Write the README and publish the app on a static host.
userStories: As a team, I want documentation and a live link so that others can use the app.
